name: PRETTYBOY Inc. is Hiring!
source:
You just got out of college, money's tight, and you're willing to try anything. That's when you see PRETTY BOY Inc. has a job posting. A notorious company, known for hiring any guy with a decent face. It sounds easy enough, and you know what to lie about to get through a interview, because hey, who doesn't lie to get the job? 

Only issue is, you're not the only one lying here.

[From [url=https://heartsyncproductions.itch.io/prettyboy-inc-is-hiring]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚从大学毕业，资金紧张，但你愿意尝试任何事情。这时你会看到PRETTY BOY Inc. 有招聘信息。一家臭名昭著的公司，以雇用任何长相正派的人而闻名。这听起来很容易，而且你知道要撒什么谎才能通过面试，因为嘿，谁不会为了得到这份工作而撒谎呢？

唯一的问题是，你并不是唯一躺在这里的人。
